featured_reviews.name: Ram Krishna
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1 Star Review

As a senior citizen, I am deeply disappointed with the service provided by this courier company. A parcel sent by my family from Delhi to Colaba, Mumbai was supposed to be delivered on 13th June. An OTP for delivery was sent in the morning, but the parcel was never handed over. Despite this, the shipment was falsely marked as "Delivered" later the same day.

Since then, my family and I have made numerous calls, filed complaints, and visited the office multiple times. Unfortunately, we have received only excuses and contradictory statements from the staff. One person says the parcel is with the delivery executive, another says it is in the office, and later a different explanation is given.

Such negligence and lack of accountability are unacceptable. Customers place trust in courier services to safely and honestly deliver their parcels. Marking a parcel as delivered without actual delivery is highly irresponsible and causes unnecessary stress and inconvenience.

I am extremely dissatisfied with the overall experience. Poor customer service, poor communication, and no sense of responsibility. I would not recommend this courier service to anyone.

featured_reviews.name: Akhilesh kumar Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
*Extremely poor and unprofessional service*.
My parcel was booked from Delhi to Colaba, Mumbai and was scheduled for delivery on 13th. On the morning of 13th, I received a delivery OTP around 11 AM, but the parcel was never delivered. Surprisingly, the shipment was marked as "Delivered" around 4 PM without any actual delivery.

Since then, I have been continuously following up through customer care, complaints, and personal visits to the office, but no satisfactory response has been provided. Every time I contact them, I receive a different excuse. First, the delivery executive claimed the parcel was with him and would be delivered the same day. Later, he said it was lying in the office and he had the key. The next day, he again changed his statement and said it was in a drop box at the office.

It has been several days, and I am still waiting for my parcel. Marking a shipment as delivered without actually delivering it is highly irresponsible and unacceptable. The lack of accountability, poor communication, and false updates have caused unnecessary stress and inconvenience.

I would not recommend this service to anyone. Please avoid if you expect reliable and professional parcel delivery.

featured_reviews.name: Kshitij Malkan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I wish 0 starts was an option to rate Om Couriers!!!!!

MY STRICT ADVISE, FIND SOMEONE ELSE AND DO NOT USE THEM!

My family and I have used Om Couriers for many years (good part of a decade, if not longer). I recently moved to Northen Ireland (part of the UK) and they started to charge extra for the extra shipping required, understandably, we agreed and the process moved on.

We continued using their services with more and more grief every time mainly arising from the increased delays (growing everytime) which found its roots in Om Couriers not making adequate payments (this is what I have come to understand) to their UK partners. Thus their UK partners (Rainbow Couriers) would not forward the parcels on. This is only fair and I have no qualms against Rainbow for this.

Moving on to our latest experience where, after 10 days we called the company to locate the parcel. As expected it was currently being held by Rainbow Couriers. At this point usually the two talk their issues out and we get the parcel in a few days following.

This time, they called back and asked me to transfer extra funds into their account. Effectively blackmailing us to get a parcel which was already paid for at their requested rate with no haggling, in fact at a premium to send it across to Northern Ireland, which according to their geography is not part of the UK and hence charge extra. The extra charges were cited as my address is in a Rural Area.

Let me assure you!!! I do not live in a rural area. It's not quiet Belfast. But it's in Belfast's neighbouring city  Lisburn. You can look it up and tell me if it's a rural village or no.

Further co-opertaing with these cheats, we offered an alternative address to my in laws home, to which they responded the same. My in laws house is a 200 yard walk from my old work address where Om Couriers have been delivering for years.

We have finally paid the extra money to have our goodgoods released from Rainbow Couriers as Om Couriers do not seem to have the strength to make their own payments.

PS - we even asked for the parcel to be sent back to India and they would charge us an extra 10000 ONE for the same. And there has been no mention to even refund the extra money charged to us for having delivered to Northern Ireland.

Ridiculous service..... Do not Use these cheats.
